items.text: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
items.topic: Supplication for Prayer in One's Offspring
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication."

items.text: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَاماً
items.topic: Comfort of the Eyes and Righteous Leadership
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."

items.text: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحاً تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring."

items.text: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.topic: Comprehensive Supplication for Good in Both Worlds
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire."

items.text: وَاعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئاً ۖ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَاناً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Worship Allah and associate nothing with Him, and to parents do good."

items.text: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قُوا أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَاراً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire."

items.text: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجاً وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن أَزْوَاجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةً
items.topic: The Blessing of Spouses, Children, and Grandchildren
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And Allah has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren."

items.text: وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَاناً ۚ إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ الْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَا أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَا أُفٍّ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], 'uff,' and do not repel them."

items.text: وَاخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيراً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, 'My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.'"

items.text: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ وَهْناً عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍ وَفِصَالُهُ فِي عَامَيْنِ أَنِ اشْكُرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيْكَ
items.topic: Gratitude to Parents and Recognizing Their Care
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents."

items.text: وَإِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَانُ لِابْنِهِ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُ يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And [mention, O Muhammad], when Luqman said to his son while he was instructing him, 'O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allah. Indeed, association [with Him] is great injustice.'"

items.text: يَا بُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا أَصَابَكَ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you."

items.text: وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَرَحاً ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful."

items.text: وَاقْصِدْ فِي مَشْيِكَ وَاغْضُضْ مِن صَوْتِكَ ۚ إِنَّ أَنكَرَ الْأَصْوَاتِ لَصَوْتُ الْحَمِيرِ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys."

items.text: الْمَالُ وَالْبَنُونَ زِينَةُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَاباً وَخَيْرٌ أَمَلاً
items.topic: Worldly Adornment and Enduring Good Deeds
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Wealth and children are [but] adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for [one's] hope."

items.text: وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَاصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا ۖ لَا نَسْأَلُكَ رِزْقاً ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you."

items.text: إِنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
items.topic: The Trust and Trial of Raising Children
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward."

items.text: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلاً سَدِيداً
items.topic: Speaking Straightforward and Just Words at Home
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "O you who have believed, fear Allah and speak words of appropriate justice."

items.text: يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزاً عَظِيماً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "He will [then] amend for you your deeds and forgive you your sins. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly attained a great attainment."

items.text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ
items.topic: Justice and Excellence in the Family
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives."

items.text: وَلَا تَسْتَوِي الْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا السَّيِّئَةُ ۚ ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ
items.topic: Repelling Evil with What Is Better
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better."

items.text: فَإِذَا الَّذِي بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُ عَدَاوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٌ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And thereupon the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend."

items.text: وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ
items.topic: The Virtue of Patience and Forbearance
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good]."

items.text: وَسَارِعُوا إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And hasten to forgiveness from your Lord and a garden as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for the righteous."

items.text: الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِي السَّرَّاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ وَالْكَاظِمِينَ الْغَيْظَ وَالْعَافِينَ عَنِ النَّاسِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Who spend [in the cause of Allah] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allah loves the doers of good."

items.text: فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِّنَ اللَّهِ لِنتَ لَهُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ كُنتَ فَظّاً غَلِيظَ الْقَلْبِ لَانفَضُّوا مِنْ حَوْلِكَ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "So by mercy from Allah, [O Muhammad], you were lenient with them. And if you had been rude [in speech] and harsh in heart, they would have disbanded from about you."

items.text: فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult them in the matter."

items.text: فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And when you have decided, then rely upon Allah. Indeed, Allah loves those who rely [upon Him]."

items.text: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful."

items.text: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْراً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease."

items.text: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانصَبْ * وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَارْغَب
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship]. And to your Lord direct [your] longing."

items.text: وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْماً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And say, 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge.'"

items.text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Indeed, Allah is with the patient."

items.text: وَبَشِّرِ الصَّابِرِينَ * الَّذِينَ إِذَا أَصَابَتْهُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَالُوا إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
items.topic: Glad Tidings for the Patient in Adversity
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And give good tidings to the patient, who, when disaster strikes them, say, 'Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.'"

items.text: أُولَٰئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَاتٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ ۖ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُهْتَدُونَ
items.topic: Mercy and Guidance for the Patient
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Those are the ones upon whom are blessings from their Lord and mercy. And it is those who are the [rightly] guided."

items.text: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And when My servants ask you, [O Muhammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me."

items.text: وَلَا تَنسَوُا الْفَضْلَ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And do not forget graciousness between you. Indeed Allah, of whatever you do, is Seeing."

items.text: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
items.topic: The Greatest Verse in the Book of Allah
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence."

items.text: مَّن ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضاً حَسَناً فَيُضَاعِفَهُ لَهُ أَضْعَافاً كَثِيرَةً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He may multiply it for him many times over?"

items.text: آَمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ
items.topic: The Closing Verses of Al-Baqarah and Tranquillity
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers."

items.text: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
items.topic: Allah's Mercy in Not Burdening Beyond Capacity
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity."

items.text: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
items.topic: Supplication for Pardon When Forgetting or Erring
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred."

items.text: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا
items.topic: Seeking Ease and Relief from Heavy Burdens
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us."

items.text: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us."

items.text: إِنَّ رَبِّي لَطِيفٌ لِّمَا يَشَاءُ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Indeed, my Lord is Subtle in what He wills. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise."

items.text: قَالَ إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
items.topic: Turning One's Grief and Sorrow to Allah Alone
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "He said, 'I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah.'"

items.text: إِنَّهُ مَن يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
items.topic: Mindfulness of Allah, Patience, and Excellence
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Indeed, he who fears Allah and is patient, then indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good."

items.text: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.topic: Ibrahim's Supplication for a Righteous Child
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

items.text: فَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِغُلَامٍ حَلِيمٍ
items.topic: The Quality of Forbearance in Children
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy."

items.text: قَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنِّي أَرَىٰ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ فَانظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ
items.topic: The Etiquette of Consulting One's Child
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "He said, 'O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think.'"

items.text: قَالَ يَا أَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِي إِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ
items.topic: Isma'il's Filial Devotion and Submission to Allah
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "He said, 'O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast.'"

items.text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ الْبَلَاءُ الْمُبِينُ * وَفَدَيْنَاهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Indeed, this was the clear trial. And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice."

items.text: وَسَلَامٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيّاً
items.topic: Peace and Safety for the Newborn
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive."

items.text: يَا يَحْيَىٰ خُذِ الْكِتَابَ بِقُوَّةٍ ۖ وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْحُكْمَ صَبِيّاً
items.topic: Wisdom in Youth and Strength in Truth
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "O John, take the Scripture with determination. And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy."

items.text: وَبَرّاً بِوَالِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّاراً عَصِيّاً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant."

items.text: قَالَ إِنِّي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ آتَانِيَ الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيّاً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "[Jesus] said, 'Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.'"

items.text: وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكاً أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَانِي بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَاةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيّاً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive."

items.text: وَبَرّاً بِوَالِدَتِي وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِي جَبَّاراً شَقِيّاً
items.topic: Humility and Kindness to One's Mother
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant."

items.text: وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيّاً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."

items.text: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَاةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِ مَرْضِيّاً
items.topic: Enjoining Prayer and Charity upon the Family
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing."

items.text: فَقُولَا لَهُ قَوْلاً لَّيِّناً لَّعَلَّهُ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]."

items.text: قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي * وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي * وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي * يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
items.topic: Supplication for an Expanded Chest and Clear Speech
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "[Moses] said, 'My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance], and ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.'"

items.text: وَاجْعَل لِّي وَزِيراً مِّنْ أَهْلِي
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And appoint for me a minister from my family."

items.text: كَيْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيراً * وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيراً * إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيراً
items.topic: Remembering Allah Together as a Family
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "That we may exalt You much and remember You much. Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."

items.text: وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّي وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِي
items.topic: Divine Love and Care Over the Child
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye."

items.text: إِذْ تَمْشِي أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَاكَ إِلَىٰ أُمِّكَ كَيْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ
items.topic: Compassion for the Mother and Comforting Her Heart
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "When your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve."

items.text: إِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُولَٰئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْئُولاً
items.topic: Responsibility for the Senses and Mindful Awareness
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned."

items.text: وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge."

items.text: وَقُل لِّعِبَادِي يَقُولُوا الَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَنزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ
items.topic: Gracious Dialogue and Guarding Against Discord
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them."

items.text: رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِي نُفُوسِكُمْ ۚ إِن تَكُونُوا صَالِحِينَ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ لِلْأَوَّابِينَ غَفُوراً
items.topic: Forgiveness for Those Who Turn Back to Allah
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves. If you should be righteous [in intention] - then indeed He is ever, to the often returning [to Him], Forgiving."

items.text: وَآتِ ذَا الْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُ وَالْمِسْكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيراً
items.topic: Fulfilling the Rights of Relatives and Avoiding Extravagance
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And give the relative his right, and [also] the poor and the traveler, and do not spend wastefully."

items.text: وَإِمَّا تُعْرِضَنَّ عَنْهُمُ ابْتِغَاءَ رَحْمَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ تَرْجُوهَا فَقُل لَّهُمْ قَوْلاً مَّيْسُوراً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And if you [must] turn away from the needy awaiting mercy from your Lord which you expect, then speak to them a gentle word."

items.text: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ الْبَسْطِ فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُوماً مَّحْسُوراً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck or extend it completely and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent."

items.text: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَنفَقُوا لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَاماً
items.topic: Moderation and Balance in the Household
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate."

items.text: وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا كِرَاماً
items.topic: Turning Away from Ill Speech with Dignity
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity."

items.text: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا عَلَيْهَا صُمّاً وَعُمْيَاناً
items.topic: Heeding the Signs of Allah Mindfully
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind."

items.text: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
items.topic: Serenity of Heart in Remembering Allah
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured."

items.text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves."

items.text: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحاً مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُ حَيَاةً طَيِّبَةً
items.topic: A Good Life Through Faith and Righteous Deeds
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life."

items.text: ادْعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ ۖ وَجَادِلْهُم بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ
items.topic: Calling to Good with Wisdom and Kind Instruction
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction, and argue with them in a way that is best."

items.text: وَاصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ۚ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ
items.topic: Patience Through Allah and Freedom from Distress
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And be patient, [O Muhammad], and your patience is not but through Allah. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire."

items.text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوا وَّالَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ
items.topic: Allah Is with the Mindful and the Doers of Good
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good."

items.text: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ
items.topic: Responding to What Gives Life to the Heart
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "O you who have believed, respond to Allah and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life."

items.text: وَاتَّقُوا فِتْنَةً لَّا تُصِيبَنَّ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنكُمْ خَاصَّةً ۖ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
items.topic: Guarding Against Trials to Protect the Next Generation
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And fear a trial which will not strike those who have wronged among you exclusively, and know that Allah is severe in penalty."

items.text: فَابْتَغُوا عِندَ اللَّهِ الرِّزْقَ وَاعْبُدُوهُ وَاشْكُرُوا لَهُ
items.topic: Seeking Provision Through Worship and Gratitude
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "So seek from Allah provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him."

items.text: وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ
items.topic: Entering and Exiting with Truth and Sincerity
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And say, 'My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit.'"

items.text: وَاجْعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَاناً نَّصِيراً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."

items.text: وَقُلْ جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الْبَاطِلُ ۚ إِنَّ الْبَاطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقاً
items.topic: The Triumph of Truth Over Falsehood
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And say, 'Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart.'"

items.text: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
items.topic: The Qur'an as Healing and Mercy
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers."

items.text: قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلاً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Say, 'Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way.'"

items.text: وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا
items.topic: Morning and Evening Praise and Remembrance
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting."

items.text: وَمِنْ آنَاءِ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied."

items.text: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجاً مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life."

items.text: وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ
items.topic: The Enduring Provision of Your Lord
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring."

items.text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ۚ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيماً
items.topic: Sending Blessings upon the Prophet at Home
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allah to grant him] peace."

items.text: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكْراً كَثِيراً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance."

items.text: وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلاً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And exalt Him morning and afternoon."

items.text: هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلَائِكَتُهُ لِيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ
items.topic: Being Led Out of Darkness into Light
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "It is He who confers blessing upon you, and His angels [ask Him to do so] that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light."

items.text: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلْتَنظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "O you who have believed, fear Allah. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow."

items.text: وَلَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ نَسُوا اللَّهَ فَأَنسَاهُمْ أَنفُسَهُمْ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And be not like those who forgot Allah, so He made them forget themselves."

items.text: لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهُ خَاشِعاً مَُّتَصَدِّعاً مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ
items.topic: The Awe-Inspiring Impact of the Qur'an
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "If We had sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and coming apart from fear of Allah."

items.text: وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought."

items.text: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ ۖ هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.topic: Knowing Allah's Names and Encompassing Mercy
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful."

items.text: فَاصْبِرْ صَبْراً جَمِيلاً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "So be patient with gracious patience."

items.text: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيداً * وَنَرَاهُ قَرِيباً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Indeed, they see it [as] distant, but We see it [as] near."

items.text: فَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ وَمَن تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to Allah], and do not transgress."

items.text: وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفاً مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ ۚ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds."

items.text: وَاصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
items.topic: The Reward of the Doers of Good Is Never Lost
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good."

items.text: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ الْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُ فَاعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ
items.topic: Returning All Matters to Allah and Relying on Him
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And to Allah belong the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth and to Him will be returned the matter, all of it, so worship Him and rely upon Him."

items.text: إِنَّ الدِّينَ عِندَ اللَّهِ الْإِسْلَامُ
items.topic: The Religion with Allah Is Islam
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam."

items.text: قُلْ إِن كُنتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللَّهَ فَاتَّبِعُونِي يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ
items.topic: Attaining Allah's Love by Following the Prophet
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Say, [O Muhammad], 'If you should love Allah, then follow me, [so] Allah will love you and forgive you your sins.'"

items.text: وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful."

items.text: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ وَأَنبَتَهَا نَبَاتاً حَسَناً
items.topic: Nurturing the Child with Goodly Growth
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner."

items.text: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "At that, Zechariah called upon his Lord, saying, 'My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.'"

items.text: فَنَادَتْهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي فِي الْمِحْرَابِ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيَىٰ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "So the angels called him while he was standing in prayer in the chamber, 'Indeed, Allah gives you good tidings of John.'"

items.text: مُصَدِّقاً بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَسَيِّداً وَحَصُوراً وَنَبِيّاً مِّنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.topic: Qualities of a Righteous and Blessed Child
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Confirming a word from Allah and [who will be] honorable, abstaining [from women], and a prophet from among the righteous."

items.text: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكْراً كَثِيراً * وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلاً
items.topic: Morning and Evening Remembrance of Allah
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance, and exalt Him morning and afternoon."

items.text: وَقُل رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And, [O Muhammad], say, 'My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.'"

items.text: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ * وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
items.topic: Seeking Refuge for the Home from Evil Promptings
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And say, 'My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.'"

items.text: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَاماً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering."

items.text: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي * وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
items.topic: Supplication for Ease and Peace of Heart
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task."

items.text: إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."

items.text: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And when I am ill, it is He who cures me."

items.text: وَالَّذِي هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِي وَيَسْقِينِ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink."

items.text: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْماً وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
items.topic: Supplication for Wisdom and Joining the Righteous
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous."

items.text: وَاجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations."

items.text: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ
items.topic: Supplication for the Garden of Pleasure
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure."

items.text: وَلَا تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ * يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ * إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
items.topic: Coming to Allah with a Sound Heart
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected - the Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children, but only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."

items.text: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكاً مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ
items.topic: Smiling Kindness and Gratitude for Blessings
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, 'My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me.'"

items.text: وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحاً تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."

items.text: قَالَ هَٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّي لِيَبْلُوَنِي أَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ
items.topic: Recognizing Allah's Favor and the Test of Gratitude
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "He said, 'This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful.'"

items.text: وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّي غَنِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ
items.topic: The Benefit of Gratitude Returns to Oneself
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."

items.text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَغَفَرَ لَهُ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "He said, 'My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me,' and He forgave him."

items.text: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
items.topic: Humbly Seeking Allah's Good and Provision
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."

items.text: فَجَاءَتْهُ إِحْدَاهُمَا تَمْشِي عَلَى اسْتِحْيَاءٍ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Then one of the two women came to him walking with shyness."

items.text: إِنَّ خَيْرَ مَنِ اسْتَأْجَرْتَ الْقَوِيُّ الْأَمِينُ
items.topic: The Qualities of Strength and Trustworthiness
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "Indeed, the best one you can hire is the strong and the trustworthy."

items.text: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
items.topic: Striving for Allah's Sake and Receiving Guidance
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good."

items.text: فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
items.topic: Glorifying Allah in the Evening and the Morning
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "So exalted is Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning."

items.text: وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيّاً وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon."

items.text: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجاً لِّتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquillity in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy."

items.text: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفاً ۚ فِطْرَتَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "So direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fitrah of Allah upon which He has created [all] people."

items.text: لا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
items.meaning: Interpretation of the meaning: "No change should there be in the creation of Allah. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know."

items.text: Start your day by smiling at your children: meeting them with a cheerful face is a good deed, and a home takes its shape from the first moment of the morning.
items.source: Parenting guidance — drawn from the hadith «لا تحقرن من المعروف شيئا ولو أن تلقى أخاك بوجه طلق» (Sahih Muslim 2626)

items.text: Before you criticise, put your hand on your child's head and lower your voice: «الرفق لا يكون في شيء إلا زانه» — gentleness adorns whatever it touches.
items.source: Parenting guidance — drawn from the hadith on gentleness (Sahih Muslim 2594)

items.text: Set aside ten minutes a day to listen to your child without interrupting — it tells them they are safe and respected.
Do not compare your children to each other or to anyone else's; being fair between them starts with seeing each one as themselves.
items.source: Parenting guidance — drawn from: «فاتقوا الله واعدلوا بين أولادكم» (Sahih al-Bukhari 2587)

items.text: This week, teach your child that seeking knowledge is a path to Paradise, and encourage them to learn something new every day.
items.source: Parenting guidance — drawn from the hadith on knowledge

items.text: Mark the smallest achievement with a kind word: constructive praise builds a confident child who loves doing good.
When your child angers you, take a breath before you answer: «الصبر عند الصدمة الأولى» — patience counts at the first shock.
items.source: Parenting guidance — drawn from the hadith on patience (Sahih al-Bukhari 1283)

items.text: Read your child the story of a prophet or a companion each night before sleep: the heart grows through example.
Do not let worship disappear from the house; praying in congregation with your children — even two rak'ahs — is more powerful than a thousand sermons.
Forgive yourself for your parenting mistakes and ask Allah to guide you: a parent is a shepherd, and a shepherd sometimes errs and then puts it right.
items.source: Parenting guidance — drawn from the hadith of the shepherd

items.text: Replace “don't do that” with “what if we did this instead?” — positive direction builds responsiveness.
When your child does wrong, separate the child from the behaviour: you are dear to us, and this particular thing was wrong.
Give your child a small corner of the house for reading and quiet — a visible invitation to settle.
Accept your child's apology at once, and teach them to repair what they broke rather than simply be punished for it.
When your child speaks, come down to their eye level and put down whatever is in your hands — there is no higher respect.
Get your children used to saying “thank you” and “Jazak Allah khayran” for any help around the house.
Take your child to the mosque gently and cheerfully, and teach them stillness through love rather than fear.
Make Friday feel different at home: good scent, and Surat al-Kahf read together.
Bring your children into cooking or setting the table — working together is where responsibility grows.
When you shop, teach your child the difference between a real need and a passing want.
Keep a small jar at home called “the good jar”, where your child puts whatever they like for those in need.
Do not shout at a crying child. Say instead: I am here with you, and when you are calm we will talk.
Hug your children several times a day: a hug releases the hormones of safety and closeness.
Listen to your child's small stories with real attention, so that they trust you when they grow up and face big problems.
Promise your child nothing you cannot deliver: keeping your word is the ground their sense of safety stands on.
Teach your child how to say “no” to a stranger, or to anything that makes them uncomfortable.
Set screen and phone hours for the house, and be the first to keep to them.
Keep the dinner table completely free of phones: mealtime is the family's talking time.
Praise the attempt and the effort spent, not only the cleverness or the result: “I am proud of how hard you worked.”
Teach your children to settle their small disagreements by talking and taking turns.
When your child is angry, help them put the feeling into words: “I can see that this upset you.”
Say the morning and evening adhkar out loud at home, so your children learn them simply by hearing them again and again.
Hold a fifteen-minute family sitting each week on one simple point of faith or character.
Encourage your children into a sport that serves them — swimming or running — so the body is built well.
Do not discuss your child's faults in front of relatives or friends: their dignity and their modesty are an amanah (trust).
If you find out your child did wrong, take it up with them alone in the room — not in front of their brothers and sisters.
Teach your child that asking permission before entering a room is an adab the Qur'an taught, and it protects everyone's privacy.
Train your child to keep the household's business inside the house.
Let your child choose their own clothes, within reason, so they learn to decide and to stand on their own.
Teach your children never to mock anyone for their looks, their colour or their clothes: «إن الله لا ينظر إلى صوركم» — Allah does not look at your forms.
items.source: Parenting guidance — drawn from the hadith «إن الله لا ينظر إلى صوركم» (Sahih Muslim 2564)

items.text: Thank your wife in front of the children, and thank your husband in front of them: how the two of you treat each other is what they copy.
When you travel or go out, bring the children into the planning and let them choose some of it.
Put up a simple daily chart and let your child tick off a prayer or a piece of homework once it is done.

Teach your child istighfar and the du'a of Yunus in distress: «لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ» (al-Anbiya' 21:87 — interpretation of the meaning, Saheeh International: “There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.”)
When you see your child helping anyone at all, thank them and praise them on the spot: “how beautiful your hands are when they help.”
Teach your son that manhood is in gentleness and in protecting the weak — not in force or in shouting.
Teach your daughter modesty, and pride in who she is and in her noble Islamic character.
Explain the reason behind a rule simply, instead of handing down a bare order.
Be patient with your child's many questions: curiosity is the engine of intelligence and learning.
If you do not know the answer to your child's question about faith or science, say so honestly: “good question — let's go and find out together.”
Teach your child the du'a for entering and leaving the bathroom, so adab reaches even the smallest corner of their day.
Teach your child the du'a for riding in a vehicle, and to seek blessings when moving about and travelling.
Keep a small library at home with illustrated stories of the prophets.
Encourage your child to read by leaving a book beside their bed every night.
At meals, get your child used to never criticising food: if they want it they eat it, and if not they leave it politely.
Teach your child not to waste water in wudu or in the shower: looking after a blessing is how you thank Allah for it.
Train your child to switch off lights and unused devices to develop a sense of responsibility.
When visiting relatives, teach your children a warm greeting, asking permission, and how to sit with people.
If your child is afraid of something, never make light of the fear — hold them and make them feel safe.
Teach your child to honour a trust: a toy borrowed from a friend goes back whole and clean.
Get your children used to telling the truth and owning a mistake without fearing what follows.
Make bedtime a warm moment: a hand on the head, the last two surahs, and a du'a for good.
If your child had a hard day at school, listen first and be the safe place they come back to.
Teach your child that failing is not the end of the world — it is another go at learning something.
Let your child try things and discover under your eye, without tying their hands entirely.
Teach your children to respect the elderly and to help them carry what is heavy.
Get your children used to kindness towards animals and never harming them: «في كل كبد رطبة أجر» — there is reward in every living creature.
items.source: Parenting guidance — drawn from the hadith «في كل كبد رطبة أجر» (Sahih al-Bukhari 2363)

items.text: When your child plants a plant or a tree, remind them that a reward is written for them for everyone who benefits from it.
Teach your child to respect their teachers, to listen politely, and to remember what they owe them.
Keep a small signal or a password between you and your children — a quick, private way to reach each other.
Do not step into every detail of your children's play unless there is danger: let them negotiate it out.
Teach your child that apologising is strength, not weakness, and that what makes it possible is humility.
Let your home be one where Allah's name is said often — in tasbih, in praise, in du'a.
Get your child used to keeping promises and appointments: a Muslim who promises, delivers.
Teach your children to compete in doing good, without bitterness or envy.
If you see a gift in your child — drawing, calligraphy, memorising Qur'an — feed it and cheer it on.
Have your children make du'a for your parents, their grandparents, for mercy and health — that is how lasting birr is planted.
Teach your child never to spy on or sneak a look into other people's private matters.
When there is trouble between your children, hear each one alone and without taking a side, before you judge.
Teach your child that digital honesty is knowing Allah sees them on the internet and on the phone as everywhere else.
Steer your child towards content that is useful and right for their age, so the hours are not simply spent.
Explain to your child that games and phones are a small amusement, not the whole of life.
Teach your children to visit their cousins on both sides — this is how the ties of kinship are kept strong.
Let your children help choose and wrap the Eid gifts, and spread the joy with you.
Teach your child salat al-istikhara for when they are torn between two good options.
Get your children used to saying bismillah before drinking, thanking Allah after, and drinking in three breaths.
Teach your child not to talk with food in their mouth — for their safety as much as for good manners.
When your child looks sad, ask: “would you like me to listen, or would you like a hug?”
Teach your child that a beautiful character leaves a deeper mark on people than expensive clothes ever do.
Get your children used to the dhikr for leaving the house: «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ» — in the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah.
Teach your children to say bismillah and to praise Allah when they put on new clothes.
Keep a box at home for recycling paper or saving leftover food — developing a sense of responsibility.
Teach your child to lay out their day between prayer, schoolwork, play and sleep.
Thank your child when they do what you asked the first time: praise reinforces quick responsiveness.
If your child is struggling with a subject, help them through it in small encouraging steps and without tension.
Teach your child that swallowing anger and forgiving a friend is something Allah raises them for.
Get your children used to giving salam out loud when they come into the house.
Teach your child that Allah sees in the dark as He sees in the light: mindfulness of Allah is the secret of righteousness.
Let your child feel that their home is the safest, most loving place in the world.
Remember that du'a made for your children when they are not there works wonders: never tire of making it.
Teach your child that hardship is an opening for patience and for drawing nearer to Allah — not anger from Him.
Tell your child, again and again, that your love does not depend on their performance or their marks.
Teach your child to make du'a for themselves, for their parents and for the Muslims after every prayer.
Build good memories with your children in every season and every Eid.
Be the support your child always turns to, so they never go looking for it among strangers.
Teach your child to take pride in their faith, their values and their character with confidence and love.
Remember that your children read what you do and where you stand far more closely than they listen to your advice.
And last: ask Allah, blessed and exalted is He, every day for guidance, success, and blessings for your children.
Give your child a moment to think before sleep, and ask: “what was the best thing that happened today, and what made you happy?”
Teach your children to respect privacy and never to open someone else's messages or devices without asking.
If your child is worked up or angry, give them a cushion or a squeeze toy to let the charge out safely.
Teach your children to seek refuge in Allah from the accursed shaytan when anger stirs.
Set aside time for the family every day with no screens or phones to encourage direct conversation.
If you promised your child a reward for finishing something, give it the moment they finish.
Train your child to pack their own school bag and lay out their clothes each evening before bed.
Teach your child the bedtime du'a: «باسمك اللهم أموت وأحيا», and reassure them that Allah protects them while they sleep.
Keep a chart at home that rotates the small chores between the children , to cultivate fairness and responsibility.
Thank your child warmly, and in front of everyone, when they go and help a friend or a neighbour.
If your child mispronounces a word or an ayah, correct it calmly and kindly, and never laugh at them.
Teach your child that truth always brings you out, and that lying cuts the rope of trust and safety.
Train your children to switch the devices off and get ready for bed an hour early, so the mind can settle.
If your child has a hard project or assignment, break it down with them into small, encouraging steps.
Teach your child that their body is their own, and that nobody may touch them in a way that makes them uncomfortable.
Before sleep, take your child's hand, read the bedtime adhkar together, and praise the good things they did today.
items.topic: Parenting with love and emotional support

items.text: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
items.meaning: The best of you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.

items.text: مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمُ لاَ يُرْحَمُ
items.topic: Affection and Showing Mercy to Children
items.meaning: Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.

items.text: إِنَّمَا يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الرُّحَمَاءَ
items.meaning: Allah shows mercy only to those of His servants who are merciful.

items.text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ
items.meaning: Indeed, Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.

items.text: لا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
items.meaning: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

items.text: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
items.meaning: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.

items.text: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ إِلاَّ مِنْ صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
items.topic: A Righteous Child's Supplication for Parents
items.meaning: When a human being dies, his deeds come to an end except from three: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child who prays for him.

items.text: الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ
items.topic: Sincere Care and Advice for the Family
items.meaning: Religion is sincere goodwill and counsel.

items.text: لاَ تَغْضَبْ
items.meaning: Do not become angry.

items.text: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
items.meaning: A Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.

items.text: مَنْ عَالَ جَارِيَتَيْنِ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَا جَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَنَا وَهُوَ
items.topic: Mercy Toward Daughters and Caring for Them
items.meaning: Whoever looks after two girls until they come of age will come on the Day of Resurrection, he and I.

items.text: السَّاعِي عَلَى الأَرْمَلَةِ وَالْمِسْكِينِ كَالْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، أَوِ الْقَائِمِ اللَّيْلَ الصَّائِمِ النَّهَارَ
items.meaning: The one who strives to support the widow and the poor is like one who strives in the cause of Allah, or like one who stands in prayer all night and fasts all day.

items.text: بَلِّغُوا عَنِّي وَلَوْ آيَةً
items.topic: Calling to Good Within the Family
items.meaning: Convey from me, even if it is a single verse.

items.text: اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ وَلِيَ مِنْ أَمْرِ أُمَّتِي شَيْئًا فَشَقَّ عَلَيْهِمْ فَاشْقُقْ عَلَيْهِ وَمَنْ وَلِيَ مِنْ أَمْرِ أُمَّتِي شَيْئًا فَرَفَقَ بِهِمْ فَارْفُقْ بِهِ
items.topic: Gentleness Toward Those in Your Care
items.meaning: O Allah, whoever is given charge of any affair of my nation and is harsh with them, be harsh with him; and whoever is given charge of any affair of my nation and is gentle with them, be gentle with him.

items.text: إِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَصْدُقُ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ صِدِّيقًا وَإِنَّ الْكَذِبَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْفُجُورِ وَإِنَّ الْفُجُورَ يَهْدِي إِلَى النَّارِ وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَكْذِبُ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ كَذَّابًا
items.meaning: Indeed, truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise, and a man keeps telling the truth until he is recorded as truthful. And lying leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to the Fire, and a man keeps lying until he is recorded as a liar.
